CuraScript SD is a specialty distribution business owned by **Evernorth**, which is the health services division of **The Cigna Group**. Express Scripts (acquired by Cigna in 2018) also acts as an intermediate parent entity alongside Evernorth. [](https://www.evernorth.com/article/evernorth-names-pete-perron-president-curascript-sd)

- **Ultimate Parent:** The Cigna Group

- **Division:** Evernorth

- **Subsidiary / Business Unit:** CuraScript SD [](https://www.evernorth.com/article/evernorth-names-pete-perron-president-curascript-sd)

### Key Details

- **Focus:** Distributes biologics, vaccines, and infused medications to healthcare providers.

- **Sister Company:** Operates alongside Accredo, a specialty pharmacy under the same corporate umbrella.

- **Headquarters:** Lake Mary, Florida. [](https://bo.linkedin.com/company/curascriptspecialtydistribution)

CuraScript SD, a specialty distribution arm of
Evernorth Health Services
(The Cigna Group), distributes sensitive biologics, rare-disease orphan drugs, cell and gene therapies, vaccines, and infused medications rather than typical consumer retail prescriptions.
Evernorth Health Services
Product Portfolios and Categories
Biologics & Biosimilars:
Complex protein-based drugs and follow-on biologic alternatives.
Rare Disease & Orphan Drugs:
High-touch, ultra-sensitive medications requiring specialized handling.
Cell & Gene Therapies:
Cutting-edge personalized treatments with strict chain-of-identity protocols.
Vaccines & Infused Medications:
Temperature-monitored clinical supplies for provider administration.
Ancillary Supportive Care:
Complementary products utilized alongside active specialty treatments.
